map.最大心率一定要用 220−年龄吗？: Must maximum heart rate be 220 minus age?
map.220−年龄是最粗略估计，个体差异可达 ±10–15 bpm。更准可用「储备心率: 220 minus age is the roughest estimate; individual variation can reach +/-10-15 bpm. For better accuracy use the 'heart rate reserve method (Karvonen)' or a measured treadmill test. This tool lets you enter measured maxHr/lthr directly, which fits the individual better than plugging into a formula.
map.减脂是不是心率越高越好？: Is a higher heart rate always better for fat loss?
map.不是。脂肪供能比例在中等强度（约 60–70% 最大心率，即 Z2）最高，过高强: No. The proportion of energy from fat peaks at moderate intensity (about 60-70% of maximum heart rate, i.e. Z2); at higher intensity the body switches to glycogen and the effort is hard to sustain. Fat loss depends on 'total fat oxidation = intensity x duration', so long Z2 sessions usually beat short sprints.
